description: QuoteCraft is a quoting app for independent contractors and small trade businesses. A quote is built from line items, typed in or picked from a service catalog, with its tax rate and valid-until date; it is exported as a PDF and sent by email, and it moves from Draft to Sent, Accepted, Declined or Expired, with a reminder three days before it expires. A client directory, a business profile that sets the defaults, and Light, Dark or system themes complete it. Data stays on the device in an encrypted SQLite database (SQLCipher); Supabase sign-in and Stripe billing appear only when a project is configured. One Uno Platform single project for desktop, the browser, Android and iOS, with MVUX models, Navigation Extensions (tab and detail regions, dialogs and a drawer as routes), the Uno Toolkit's responsive layouts, Material, and PDFs drawn with SkiaSharp on every head.

showcase.summary: Quotes for contractors: line items from a catalog, a PDF on every platform and a status lifecycle, local-first.
goals: MVUX models over a local SQLCipher database, with loading, empty and error states and Retry on every page
Navigation Extensions: tab and list-detail regions, ContentDialog routes that return typed results, and a drawer route
Four responsive layouts with the Uno Toolkit: bottom tabs on a phone, a side rail and list beside detail on a wide window
Material theming with Light, Dark and the system theme, chosen in the app and remembered
A quote PDF drawn with SkiaSharp's SKDocument on every head: saved on desktop, downloaded in the browser, offered to the save dialog on Android and iOS
Optional Supabase sign-in and Stripe billing that stay hidden when no project is configured
requires: An email app on the device to send a quote (a mailto link; the PDF is attached by hand)
